2. Short facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted a suit in the Court of the Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar Noakhali being Title Suit No. 403 of 1987, against opposite parties No. 3-9 for declaration of title in the suit land measuring 1.08 acres described in the schedule of the plaint stating inter alia that Ram Kanai Shil, grand father of the petitioner was the original owner of the suit land by way of settlement from the Zaminder on executing kabuliayt in 1322 B.S. and since then he has been owning and possessing the same on payment of rent to the landlords and living there with the member of his family after constructing dwelling huts therein. It has been alleged that the M.R.R. khatian has been wrongly prepared in the names of the defendants and hence the suit for declaration of title for removing the cloud cast over their title. 

 3. Defendant No.1 contested the suit by filing written statements denying all the material allegations of the plaint and contended inter alia that the suit as framed is not maintainable in law and it is barred by limitation. It has been contended that the suit land has been rightly recorded in the M.R.R. Khatian in the names of the defendants who own and possess the same in their own right. The plaintiff has no right, title and possession in the suit and the plaintiff filed the suit against the defendants on false and frivolous allegations for illegal gains.
